other_conditions: Eligible institutions include technical colleges, universities, professional institutes, R&D institutes, NGOs involved in incubation activities, MSME‑DIs/Technology Centres, or any central/state government institute or organization.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹15 lakh per idea for development and nurturing, and up to ₹1 crore for procurement and installation of plant and machines for the incubator.
